jobs.title: Agile / Project Manager
jobs.description:
Agile / Project Manager

Location:
United States

Job Type:
Full-Time

Job Overview We are seeking an organized and results-driven Agile / Project Manager
to lead and coordinate projects using Agile methodologies. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, manage timelines, coordinate resources, remove obstacles, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, and manage projects from initiation through completion.
Apply Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and iterative project management practices.
Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Track project progress, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items.
Remove or escalate project blockers that may affect delivery.
Coordinate resources and ensure team members understand project priorities.
Communicate project status, risks, and key updates to stakeholders and management.
Manage project documentation, reports, and performance metrics.
Support backlog planning, prioritization, and sprint execution.
Identify opportunities to improve team productivity and project delivery processes.
Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, and quality requirements.
Ensure projects align with business objectives and stakeholder expectations.

Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
2–5 years of experience in project management, Agile delivery, Scrum, or a related field.
Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and multiple project priorities.
Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Asana, Monday.com, Trello, or similar platforms.
Ability to manage deadlines, risks, and competing priorities.
Strong stakeholder-management and presentation skills.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PMP, PMI-ACP, or similar certification.
Experience working with software development or technology teams.
Knowledge of Agile planning, backlog management, and sprint metrics.
Experience with Jira and Confluence.
Understanding of project budgeting, resource planning, and risk management.
Experience leading process improvement initiatives.
Ability to work effectively in remote and distributed team environments.

What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
Remote, hybrid, or on-site work options depending on the position.
Professional development and certification opportunities.
Training and mentorship.
Collaborative and Agile working environment.
Paid time off and company benefits for eligible employees.
Opportunities to lead high-impact projects and advance within project management.

Salary Estimated Salary Range:
$80,000–$120,000 per year, depending on experience, location, qualifications, and employer.

jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Project Manager concentrates on learning the basics of Project Management and developing the skills necessary to begin a career in Project Management. The Project Manager will analyze and solve a multitude of business challenges while growing their skillset. This will include managing resources, coordinating the efforts of team members and shadowing current employees as they deliver the solutions offered by AHEAD Services. The Project Manager will also strive to develop the skills necessary to attain PM certifications as appropriate (PMP, Certified Scrum Master, etc).

Responsibilities

Plan and coordinate all aspects of technical projects from initiation through delivery.
Help ensure service delivery success and customer satisfaction through effective project management.
Help manage incidents and communication to various clients.
Work closely with Senior Project Managers and Program Managers on project tasks and provide project status updates regularly.
Utilize Ahead systems and various management tools to maintain updated project information.
Assist in developing Project Change Requests (PCR’s) and customer presentations.
Develop customer relationships and aids in identifying additional sales opportunities.
Identify and execute on opportunities and efforts to ensure customer success.
Develop, define, and execute project plans, project scope, activities, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Develop and distribute project status reports to internal management and client project teams.
Coordinate activities and tasks among project team members, other internal departments, and client or vendor/subcontractor organizations as needed to meet project goals, and ensures project completion is on schedule, within budget constraints, and of the appropriate quality standards for the project scope.
Manage project risks, issues/problems, and activity progress to ensure project goals (e.g., deadline, scope and quality) are achieved.
Conduct project closure activities to formalize and communicate the project acceptance, handover documentation, and ongoing activities.
Must pursue professional self-development opportunities on a regular basis.

Qualifications

Working knowledge of Project Management foundations
Any of the following preferred but not required: Certified Associate in Project Manager (CAPM), Certified Junior Agile Project Manager (IAPM)
Willingness to travel to support client projects and shadowing opportunities (50+ % of the time)

Graduated with a degree in technical discipline by 6/08/26

Successful completion in a technical–related bootcamp
Working knowledge of technology, cloud and application development

$105,000 - $140,000 a year

jobs.description:
Project Manager II

CalOptima

Join Us in this Amazing Opportunity

The Team You'll Join

We are a mission driven community-based organization that serves member health with excellence and dignity, respecting the value and needs of each person. If you are ready to advance your career while making a difference, we encourage you to review and apply today and help us build healthier communities for all.

More About The Opportunity

We are hoping you will join us as a Project Manager II
and help shape the future of healthcare where you'll be an integral part of our Enterprise Project Management Office
team, helping to strive for excellence while we serve our member health with dignity, respecting the value and needs of each of our members through collaboration with our providers, community partners and local stakeholders. This position has been approved to be Full Telework
.

If telework is approved, you are required to work within the State of California only and if Partial Telework, also come in to the Main Office in Orange, CA, at least two (2) days per week minimum.

The Project Manager II will effectively support all aspects of a project throughout its lifecycle with oversight and direction, including but not limited to the scope, schedule, resources, quality, cost and change. You will be responsible for delivering on small and medium projects running simultaneously that will involve coordination of multiple impacted areas throughout the organization. You will interface and communicate with project stakeholders, representatives of other agencies and vendors during the delivery of the project. Additionally, you will provide project status monitoring and reporting to project stakeholders as required. Project assignments will involve technology and/or business-related initiatives. Together, we are building a stronger, more equitable health system.

Your Contributions To The Team

90% - Project Management
Participates in a mission-driven culture of high-quality performance, with a member focus on customer service, consistency, dignity and accountability.
Assists the team in carrying out department responsibilities and collaborates with others to support short- and long-term goals/priorities for the department.
Ensures that projects are delivered with quality, agreed upon timelines and minimal disruptions due to issues or risks.
Manages multiple small to medium sized projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.
Creates project charters that include scope and objectives, project resources, known issues and risks, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical and business feasibility and regulatory compliance when appropriate.
Develops detailed project plans or tasks with resource assignments, due dates and tracks progress with minimal supervision.
Identifies and manages with key project stakeholders any changes to project scope, schedule, and resources using appropriate negotiation skills and escalations as necessary.
Manages internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of projects.
Measures project performance and proactively works to resolve issues and risks with key project stakeholders.
Develops relationships with all stakeholders and works to ensure collaboration amongst the project team.
Creates and maintains comprehensive project documentation such as status reports, risk/action/issue/decision logs and responds to inquiries about projects.
10% - Other - completes other duties as projects as assigned.

Do You Have What the Role Requires?

Bachelor's degree PLUS 2 years of experience managing projects with low to medium complexity, duration, organizational impact and costs required; an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position such as those listed above may also be qualifying.

You'll Stand Out More If You Possess The Following

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
2 years of experience working with health care delivery systems and/or in a public agency serving the related population.

What the Regulatory Agencies Need You to Possess?

N/A

Your Knowledge & Abilities To Bring To This Role

Develop rapport and establish and maintain effective working relationships with CalOptima Health's leadership and staff and external contacts at all levels and with diverse backgrounds.
Work independently and exercise sound judgment.
Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
Work a flexible schedule; available to participate in evening and weekend events.
Organize, be analytical, problem-solve and possess project management skills.
Work in a fast-paced environment and in an efficient manner.
Manage multiple projects and identify opportunities for internal and external collaboration.
Motivate and lead multi-program teams and external committees/coalitions.
Utilize computer and appropriate software (e.g., Microsoft Office: Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) and job specific applications/systems to produce correspondence, charts, spreadsheets, and/or other information applicable to the position assignment.

Your Physical Requirements (With Or Without Accommodations)

Ability to visually read information from computer screens, forms and other printed materials and information.
Ability to speak (enunciate) clearly in conversation and general communication.
Hearing ability for verbal communication/conversation/responses via telephone, telephone systems, and face-to-face interactions.
Manual dexterity for typing, writing, standing and reaching, flexibility, body movement for bending, crouching, walking, kneeling and prolonged sitting.
Lifting and moving objects, patients and/or equipment 10 to 25 pounds

Ways We Are Here For You

You'll enjoy competitive compensation for this role.
Our current hiring range is: Pay Grade: 312 - $84,092 - $134,548 ($40.43 - $64.6865).
The final salary offered will be based on education, job-related knowledge and experience, skills relevant to the role and internal equity among other factors.

This position is approved for Full Telework (

If the position is Telework, it is eligible in California only

)
A comprehensive benefits package
CalPERS pension program and additional retirement packages.
Additional benefits and perks including:
A generous PTO program
A quality work life balance
Various wellness programs
Tuition Reimbursement
Professional development opportunities
Career development opportunities
Flexible scheduling
And the satisfaction of knowing your work directly impacts and improves healthcare access for thousands of individuals and families.

Our Work Environment

Work is typically indoors and sedentary and is subject to schedule changes and/or variable work hours, with travel as needed.
There are no harmful environmental conditions present for this job.

Why Join Us?

We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Each employee brings a unique perspective to the overall team and we value everyone's input and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where you and every team member can thrive while making a meaningful impacts on our community members. Our team reflects and represents the communities we serve, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds who share our commitment to accessible, quality healthcare.

jobs.title: Operations - Project Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

The Project Manager leads key initiatives to drive improved quality, operational, and/or financial performance with a high degree of autonomy. The Project Manager partners with field teams, IT, Quality Improvement, etc. to stand-up, plan, and deliver high-impact, strategic projects. Primary responsibilities include identifying and monitoring measures of success, unblocking stuck actions through escalation or hands-on support, and facilitating transition plans upon project completion.

Essential Job Functions

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.

Project Management:
Own the successful execution and implementation of initiatives. This includes ensuring that projects are completed on time and with a quality of implementation that leads to impactful results
Compose project plans, lead workstreams, and track the progress of intended deliverables and metrics, and support adoption
Effectively identify, raise, diagnose, and solve any risks or anomalies that impact the project

Strategic Initiatives:
Lead opportunities for improvement within designated project areas with exploratory or defined scope. This may include detailing the problem, organizing a cross-functional team, and proposing and summarizing findings / recommendations that enable executive management to make critical decisions

Analysis:
When appropriate, complete analyses on current business processes, operating model and staffing levels, industry best practices, or other execution-related tasks to accelerate progress

Communication:
Communicate results, timelines and status, to a broad and targeted audience, including the most senior executives in the company, on an informal and formal basis
Facilitate discussions as a liaison between functional and field teams, including “translating” problem statements or requirements on behalf of key stakeholders

Leadership:
Influence and foster an organizational culture of innovation and collaboration across broader Sevita teams

Performs other related duties and activities as required

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

Minimum Knowledge And Skills Required By The Job

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s Degree, MBA preferred
5-10 years of professional experience with preference for those with operational consulting experience

Certificates, Licenses, And Registrations

Formal training in one or more process improvement methodologies preferred
PMP/agile certification and/or change management certification preferred

Other Skills And Abilities

Ability to direct and motivate cross-functional teams to achieve both tactical and strategic goals.
Strong analytical skills, as well as facilitation, critical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability driving performance excellence initiatives across a diverse set of services, employees, and geographies resulting in tangible quality, operational, and financial improvement
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and with a high degree of initiative.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and demands.
Strong fit into Sevita’s collaborative culture and operating model centered on individuals served.

Other Requirements

Travel as needed; 25% estimated but not guaranteed

Physical Requirements

Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Most Project Managers in this market have built their whole career in one lane: commercial or residential, new-build or restoration, rarely all of it at once. Our client, an established Ottawa-area building company, has spent the last several years doing the opposite: building out three real service lines, commercial construction, residential construction, and building envelope and restoration, instead of picking one. They’re now hiring a Project Manager who can run work across all three, because the firm has decided that range, not specialization, is what the next stage of growth needs.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Own assigned projects from award through closeout across commercial, residential, and envelope/restoration work, not a single project type on repeat
Serve as the main point of contact for clients and consultants directly, not filtered through an account layer
Manage budgets, cost forecasts, and cash flow, and call the corrective action yourself when a number moves
Tender and negotiate subcontractor and supplier contracts; manage change orders, RFIs, and submittals
Coordinate directly with site superintendents and field staff so drawings and specs actually hold on site
Carry safety and code compliance, Ontario OHSA and municipal permitting, as your responsibility, not someone else’s checklist

5+ years running commercial and/or residential construction projects, with real budget and schedule accountability, not just reporting on them
Comfortable reading the Ontario Building Code and CCDC contract forms without needing someone to translate them
Has negotiated with subcontractors and suppliers directly and knows which ones actually deliver
Building envelope or restoration exposure is a strong asset, not a requirement
PMP or Gold Seal certification, or working toward one, helps but isn’t a gate
Ready to stop specializing in one project type and start owning a varied pipeline

A project mix that spans three real service lines instead of one, with genuine range in the day-to-day work
Direct client relationships and full accountability from award to closeout, not a role boxed in by layers above you

Competitive salary ranging from $100,000 to $120,000 with performance-based bonus potential, full health and dental benefits, and a vehicle allowance or mileage reimbursement for site travel

💰 Competitive Salary — Based on Experience
| 📍 Roseville, MI (On-Site) | Full-Time

🏢 Ultimation Industries, an MCE Company | Reports to: General Manager

At Ultimation Industries, our Project Manager is the primary liaison between our engineering, purchasing, operations, and supplier teams and the customers counting on us to deliver. You will manage conveyor and automation projects from kickoff through commissioning, leading cross-functional teams, owning the schedule and budget, and making sure every milestone lands on time. Ultimation is the largest integrator of Jervis Webb overhead conveyor systems in the U.S. and a fast-growing leader in automation for automotive, e-commerce, and industrial markets. The projects you manage here go into real facilities and make a measurable difference.

If you are a technically grounded project manager with 5 or more years of experience in conveyor systems, automation, or industrial machinery and a structured PMI-based approach, this role was built for you.

Competitive salary based on experience. We take care of our team with a full benefits package:

Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Company-paid life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability insurance.
401(k) with a generous company match.
Generous PTO and paid holidays.
Tuition reimbursement
Paid parental leave.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Voluntary benefit products.

Customer Leadership

Lead customer meetings from project kickoff through completion, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle.
Negotiate scope, schedules, and expectations effectively, maintaining strong customer relationships even when challenges arise.
Manage stakeholder expectations proactively and resolve conflicts before they impact delivery.

Project Management and Execution

Apply PMI-aligned project management practices across scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management on every project.
Develop and maintain detailed project schedules covering all milestones including design release, procurement, fabrication, assembly, FAT, and installation.
Manage scope, schedule, and cost baselines through formal change control processes.
Monitor progress continuously, identify risks early, and implement mitigation strategies to keep projects on track.
Oversee both on-site and off-site project execution activities, including travel to customer sites, vendor facilities, and installation locations as required.

Team Coordination and Budget Ownership

Lead internal coordination meetings with engineering, purchasing, operations, suppliers, and vendors to align on deliverables and resolve issues quickly.
Work closely with the engineering team to define solutions, address design or manufacturing challenges, and ensure compliance with specifications.
Own the project's financial performance including cost tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Provide regular project updates to internal management and external stakeholders with clear, accurate reporting.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Must Have

Minimum 5 years of project management experience in conveyor systems, automation, or industrial machinery.
Proven success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects in manufacturing or automation environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills with the ability to manage scope, cost, and schedule trade-offs.
Proficient in project management software such as MS Project, MS Planner, or equivalent.
Working knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems used in conveyors and automation equipment.

Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Roseville, MI, Ultimation Industries is a leader in conveyor systems and custom material handling solutions, designing, manufacturing, and installing automation and assembly equipment for facilities of all sizes. Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is seeking an execution-driven Senior Deployment TPM to bridge the gap between Stord Labs—our 10,000 square foot micro-fulfillment innovation center —and our massive multi-client production network. While the core innovation team validates new robotics and operational designs within the lab, your mandate is to take those validated experiments and scale them out. You will manage the deployment of automation into pilot sites and lead network-wide rollouts. Additionally, you will focus heavily on process development and continuous improvement on the warehouse floor, ensuring that new technologies do not just drop into existing workflows, but fundamentally optimize how our facilities operate

You will operate at the center of a complex ecosystem spanning robotics vendors, operations, internal product and engineering teams, and executive stakeholders. Your mandate is to ensure operational continuity across all of these interfaces—removing friction, accelerating decision-making, and maintaining a disciplined pipeline from experimentation to enterprise-scale rollout.

This is a role for a systems-oriented program leader who thrives in ambiguity, understands deeply technical environments, and can translate between research, engineering, and operations without losing speed or precision.

What You'll Do

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.

How You Will Impact Skylo

You will own end-to-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the packet core
, the signalling plane
, and billing & settlement
. You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on-time technical delivery.

This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.v

What You'll Do

wn the MNO technical onboarding program end-to-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP-over-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS-over-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
Coordinate billing & settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
Program-manage the multi-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel-run and rollback planning, and de-risking the transition away from single-supplier dependency.
Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross-functional launch-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.

Sound like you? You bring:

You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.

8+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands-on time in the signalling plane
Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy & topology
A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

NB-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
Hands-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per-partner signalling readiness.
Working understanding of billing & settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57), RAP (TD.32), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
Demonstrated track record shipping cross-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.

It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With

NTN, NB-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
SMS-over-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP-via-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control-plane CIoT).
Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming-hub environments.
Familiarity with BCE and next-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance-system integration for billing.
Exposure to clearing-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

A single, trusted onboarding program that partner-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post-launch surprise.
The multi-supplier roaming transition de-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single-supplier lock-in surprises.
Program-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:

Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
Comprehensive benefits plan
Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

EEO Statement

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

Meet the Team

You will join a team building complex, cloud-native SaaS and AI-powered products that move from concept through production launch, adoption, and ongoing operation. The team works across product management, engineering, applied AI/ML, data, infrastructure, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market partners to deliver customer-ready capabilities at scale. This is a highly multi-functional environment where transparency, execution, rigor, and strong partnership are critical to success. The work is fast-moving, and focused on delivering enterprise-grade products and AI capabilities that are reliable, secure, and built for real-world adoption.

Your Impact

As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead sophisticated SaaS and AI-powered product initiatives from strategy through production delivery and operation. You will bring structure to ambiguous programs and drive alignment across large, multi-functional teams.

Turn product and technical strategy into clear plans, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and ownership across teams.
Lead large programs with moderate to high risk, multiple interdependencies, and impact across customers, partners, platforms, and releases.
Lead programs spanning product, engineering, design, data, applied AI/ML, infrastructure, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market teams.
Influence product and technical roadmaps by managing critical paths, sequencing, architecture dependencies, delivery tradeoffs, risks, resources, and commitments.
Lead agentic AI programs from definition through production and iteration, coordinating agent workflows, model and tool integration, grounding, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and human oversight.
Establish evaluation-driven delivery practices so AI quality, safety, latency, cost, and reliability are measured before launch and monitored in production.
Partner with engineering and quality teams to define validation, release, observability, and operational-readiness requirements for continuous integration and deployment.
Communicate program status, technical tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to executive audiences with clear recommendations.
Provide guidance and mentorship to other program managers and team members while driving a strategic horizon of one year or more.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 6+ years of related experience, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
Experience leading complex technical programs for enterprise SaaS products through production launch and ongoing operation.
Experience directly leading at least one generative AI, LLM-based, or agentic capability through development, production launch, and post-launch iteration.
Previous experience leading cross-functional technical programs through influence in a highly matrixed organization.
Experience in cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, data systems, and modern AI development and deployment practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading multi-team SaaS or AI programs involving cloud-native architecture, API integrations, data platforms, AI evaluations, security, reliability, and customer-facing production launches.
Experience with generative AI and agentic systems, including agent orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Ability to understand system architecture, identify cross-platform dependencies, facilitate engineering tradeoffs, and translate complex technical risks and decisions for executive audiences.
Experience applying fit-for-purpose development and execution practices, including Agile methodologies, to improve planning, decision-making, delivery, and learning.
Strong ability to bring structure to ambiguous initiatives, drive timely decisions, and create accountability across product, engineering, security, compliance, customer experience, and go-to-market stakeholders.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Senior Technical Program Manager

Dearborn, MI (Hybrid)

Overview / Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager and PMO Lead with experience delivering complex enterprise platforms, multi-workstream implementations, and large-scale business transformations. Job Description

This role is based in Nashville, TN. This role will require relocation to Nashville, TN if you do not reside in the region.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished Lead Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) and Server Operations programs across parts of North America.

This Lead Principal TPM will provide strategic and operational program leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix support, and automation across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish scalable program mechanisms that enable rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, workforce effectiveness, and technical rigor. This leader will partner across engineering and operations teams, standardize execution across multiple sites, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and data-driven program management.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions while improving the systems, tools, and operating rhythms that support reliable cloud infrastructure at scale.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and technically strong program leader with a proven track record of driving large-scale infrastructure, cloud operations, and automation programs through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations execution across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide program leadership for Cloud Hardware Support and Server Operations initiatives across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, break-fix operations, and operational automation.
Develop and execute scalable program frameworks capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple sites and cross-functional teams.
Lead complex, geographically distributed programs that improve operational performance, safety, security, availability, and service quality across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, strengthening program governance, and implementing best practices across regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, scripting, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and manual effort.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing program risk, dependencies, and execution gaps.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Senior technical program management experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, software development, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience driving large, geographically distributed programs across multiple teams, sites, and operational functions.
Demonstrated success scaling operational systems, program mechanisms, and execution models within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.
Strong understanding of hyperscale data center operations, distributed systems, infrastructure deployment, hardware lifecycle management, networking, storage, compute, and operational support.
Proven track record of driving operational transformation through AI, automation, intelligent tooling, scripting, process engineering, and scalable program models.
Experience leveraging emerging AI capabilities, operational analytics, Jira, Confluence, and related program tooling to improve workforce productivity, operational performance, and service quality.
Exceptional strategic thinking, technical judgment, program execution, and written and verbal communication.
Strong executive presence with the ability to present complex information clearly and influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience partnering with engineering and operations teams in collaborative, agile environments while driving clarity, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

Leadership Competencies

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Takes full accountability for the achievement of organizational results. Delivers audience-appropriate messages about financial performance and future expectations.
Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Aligns strategic priorities of own area with the direction and priorities of the broader organization.
Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Inspires and empowers others toward achievement of goals and strategies. Employs and develops the right talent at every level.
Competitive edge—Predicts changes in customer expectations; takes advantage of opportunities to shape and re-shape market propositions. Builds long-term business value. Creates a culture of innovation and encourages entrepreneurship. Strategically develops a range of options/paths to achieve business objectives within a changing environment.
Change agility—Initiates strategic change initiatives in anticipation of a changing external environment. Champions organizational change initiatives in a way that helps people understand, appreciate, and support them. Guides the organization to remain flexible in a changing, competitive environment. Fosters creativity, measured risk-taking actions, and entrepreneurial thinking in others
Mastering complexity—Makes decisions about the long-term strategy to sustainably grow the business. Creates an environment that shapes and supports cross-functional analysis of problems and decision-making. Actively supports the resolution of ambiguous, complex problems that cross organizational boundaries. Creates an environment of personal accountability and ownership for problem-solving.

Fralock is an engineered solutions provider of specialty components and subassemblies using advanced materials for high reliability, severe environment, and technically challenging applications. We develop and manufacture custom integrated solutions. Established in 1967, we are a critical solutions provider to Fortune 500 corporations, government, and targeted OEMs in a variety of industries including Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing, Medical and Life Science, Aerospace and Defense, Industrial, Electronics, and Energy. Fralock is headquartered in Valencia, CA with manufacturing locations located throughout Northern and Southern California.

VISION

To be recognized by our customers as a leading solutions provider of proprietary engineered advanced materials for high reliability, severe environment, and technically challenging applications.

MISSION

To create value, profitably grow, and share our success with all stakeholders.

CULTURE

Respect – We treat others the way they want to be treated.

Integrity – We practice a high standard of ethics in our business dealings with customers, suppliers and employees.

Responsiveness – We have a sense of urgency in responding to internal and external requests and work proactively to solve problems.

Excellence/Competence – We empower our people to continuously improve and execute high quality work. 

Teamwork – We work together to achieve Fralock business objectives by communicating at a high level, by listening and having clarity in our expectations of one another. 

Individual Accountability and Personal Responsibility – We do what we have committed to do when we committed to doing it. 

Continuous Improvement across all segments of the company

This position requires access to information controlled under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the successful candidate must be a "U.S. person" as defined in the ITAR and EAR (which generally means (i) be a citizen or national of the United States; or (ii) be a lawful permanent resident of the United States; or (iii) have been admitted to the United States as a refugee, or have been granted asylum, as specified under applicable law.

Main Functions

The Project Manager is responsible for leading customer programs and internal cross-functional projects from initiation through completion, ensuring that scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and customer expectations are clearly defined, actively managed, and successfully delivered. This role serves as the primary coordination point across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Customer Service to ensure Fralock executes with discipline, urgency, and accountability.

The successful candidate will help strengthen program execution, improve communication, identify risks early, drive timely issue resolution, and support Fralock’s commitment to reliable delivery, customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities 

Lead assigned customer programs, new product introductions, transfers, qualifications, production ramps, and strategic internal projects from launch through completion.

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, action registers, risk logs, and communication cadences.

Coordinate cross-functional activity across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution.

Serve as the central point of contact for project status, open actions, risks, customer commitments, and escalation needs.

Drive accountability by assigning owners, due dates, deliverables, and follow-up actions, ensuring commitments are completed on time.

Monitor project scope, timing, cost, resources, capacity constraints, quality requirements, and customer deliverables.

Identify risks and issues early, escalate appropriately, and facilitate problem-solving to remove roadblocks and protect customer commitments.

Support quote-to-launch and prototype-to-production activities, including engineering reviews, qualification planning, manufacturability input, material readiness, and production handoff.

Prepare and communicate project updates, dashboards, meeting notes, leadership summaries, and customer-facing status reports as needed.

Partner with Sales and Strategic Account teams to support customer communication, business reviews, site visits, escalation meetings, and program-level alignment.

Work with Operations and Supply Chain to understand capacity, material availability, lead times, production readiness, and delivery risks.

Support continuous improvement of project management tools, processes, templates, reporting routines, and governance standards.

Use ERP, CRM, Microsoft Office, and other business systems to maintain accurate project information and support data-driven decisions.

Balance customer advocacy with Fralock’s operational capabilities, profitability requirements, quality standards, and business priorities.

Follow all safety requirements and company policies.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Skills

Strong project management, organization, prioritization, and follow-through skills.

Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive completion of actions through influence and accountability.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with customers, leadership, technical teams, and production personnel.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.

Ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deliverables in a manufacturing environment.

Working knowledge of manufacturing operations, engineering change processes, quality requirements, supply chain coordination, and production planning.

Experience identifying project risks, developing mitigation plans, and escalating issues appropriately.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.

Experience with ERP, MRP, CRM, or project management systems preferred.

Ability to interpret technical drawings, customer requirements, specifications, and project documentation preferred.

Experience in aerospace and defense, semiconductor, medical device, electronics, advanced materials, or high-reliability manufacturing preferred.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.

Experience Requirements

Minimum of 5 years of project management, program management, operations, engineering, customer program, or related experience in a manufacturing or technical environment preferred.

Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, APQP, or similar certification preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

Frequent use of hands for computer work, documentation, and communication tools.

Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move throughout office and production areas as needed.

Ability to perform similar operations and tasks for extended periods.

Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. occasionally.

Work is primarily performed indoors in a temperature-controlled office and manufacturing environment.

May be required to enter production areas and use appropriate personal protective equipment, including safety glasses, gloves, and safety-toed footwear where required.

While in production areas, may be exposed to moving machinery, mechanical parts, machine oils, and hazardous materials.

Occasional travel to other Fralock facilities or customer sites may be required.

Asset Protection & Disposal (Hardware & IP): Design and enforce protocols to secure and destroy, at end of life, Sensitive Proprietary Information and IT Hardware.

Executive Protection & Threat Assessment: Conduct bespoke Threat Assessments for Executive Team (ET) members, evaluating their public-facing risk profiles, residential security, and travel safety.

8 + years of progressive experience in corporate security management, with a demonstrable track record of building and scaling physical security programs from "ground zero" in high-growth technology or financial services environments.
Expert-level proficiency in selecting, procuring, and implementing enterprise-grade, cloud-native Access Control (ACS) and Video Management Systems (VMS), specifically integrating these with HRIS and Identity Providers.

We are one of the largest insurance organizations in North America covering over five million people in more than 300,000 workplaces across Ontario. For more information, visit wsib.ca .

At The WSIB, You’ll Have The Opportunity To

explore many career paths and follow your passion
continuously learn and grow professionally
be recognized for the great work you do
participate in programs that support your health and wellbeing

jobs.title: Maritime Security - Senior Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Noblis and Noblis ESI are positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S&T) Directorate. The DHS S&T Directorate is the primary research and development arm of DHS and manages science and technology research, from development through transition, for the Department's operational components and first responders. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).

At Noblis, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S&T mission.

The Maritime Security Solutions Senior Project Analyst will provide expert-level scientific, technical, and project management support to the Maritime Security Solutions portfolio within DHS S&T HSARPA. This position serves as a Science, Engineering, Technology, and Analysis (SETA) advisor supporting HSARPA Strategy and Execution in the Maritime portfolio. The successful candidate will provide technical R&D strategy development, technology advising, and project management oversight for programs focused on improving Maritime Domain Awareness and maritime border security capabilities.

The Homeland Security Advanced Research Projects Agency (HSARPA) manages a broad portfolio of research, development, test, and evaluation (RDT&E) programs that deliver innovative solutions to address the nation's most pressing homeland security challenges. HSARPA invests in programs offering the potential for revolutionary changes in technologies that promote homeland security and accelerates the prototyping and deployment of technologies intended to reduce homeland vulnerabilities. Within S&T, HSARPA executes RDT&E to transition solution approaches, technologies, and knowledge products in support of DHS Component customers. The Maritime Security Solutions portfolio covers technologies and systems that enhance the nation's ability to detect, identify, classify, and track threats in the maritime domain, including autonomous systems, advanced sensors, data fusion architectures, and data analytics platforms.

The successful candidate will be self-motivated, operate well in a dynamic environment, effectively manage competing priorities, and be comfortable developing and providing technical recommendations to further program objectives to program leadership. This individual must be proactive in identifying technology gaps, developing R&D strategies to address capability shortfalls, and supporting execution from concept through technology transition.

This is currently a hybrid position requiring staff to be in-person at the DHS S&T client site in Washington, DC as needed in accordance with the requirements of the contract. Applicants must be located within the National Capital Region.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

Providing scientific and technical guidance on maritime security technologies, including autonomous systems, sensors, data fusion, and data analytics, to support R&D investment decisions and program execution.
Building and maintaining technical roadmaps that align R&D investments with DHS Component capability gaps and operational requirements in the maritime domain.
Providing technology advising to government program managers on emerging technologies, technical feasibility, and transition pathways for maritime security solutions.
Managing scope, schedule, and budget for assigned programs, projects, and activities, and interacting with stakeholders internal and external to S&T.
Supporting technology scouting activities to identify innovative solutions from industry, academia, national laboratories, and international partners that address maritime security capability gaps.
Conducting technology gaps analysis to identify shortfalls in current maritime security capabilities and recommending R&D investments to address those gaps.
Supporting technology transition planning and execution, including coordination with DHS operational components (CBP, USCG, ICE) to ensure successful adoption of developed technologies.
Evaluating the feasibility of technical approaches, reviewing research-related technical reports, and assessing the efficacy, safety, and lifecycle costs of proposed or realized solutions.
Monitoring R&D project technical performance against goals, developing test and evaluation methodologies, and tracking milestones and deliverables.
Conducting data analysis to inform program decisions, assess portfolio health, and support reporting requirements.
Drafting and coordinating executive-level communication materials including presentations, memos, point papers, and briefings for senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Coordinating with DHS matrix partners and with federal, state, local, and tribal stakeholders to advance maritime security technology objectives.
Communicating complex scientific and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Building and maintaining collaborative relationships among DHS, interagency partners, industry, and academic stakeholder communities.
Supporting strategic planning activities and contributing to the development of program strategies aligned with S&T and DHS priorities.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS in an Engineering or Scientific discipline + 10 years of relevant experience or Master’s + 5 years of relevant experience.

Eligibility to obtain a DHS Suitability determination.
Demonstrated project management skills, including experience managing scope, schedule, and budget for R&D programs or technology development efforts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience writing concise and clear technical documents according to established standards.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.
Experience providing scientific or technical guidance and advisory support to government program managers or senior leaders.
Proficiency working with Microsoft Office (Word, Project, Excel, and PowerPoint) and collaboration sites (Microsoft SharePoint).
Candidates must have a Secret clearance or higher, with ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Desired Qualifications

Technical background in one or more of the following areas related to maritime security: autonomous systems, sensors, data fusion, or data analytics.
Experience supporting DHS S&T, HSARPA, or similar federal R&D organizations in a SETA or advisory capacity.
Experience with maritime security technologies, maritime domain awareness systems, or border security technology programs.
Experience developing technical roadmaps and R&D investment strategies for government technology portfolios.
Demonstrated experience conducting technology scouting, technology assessments, or market surveys to identify innovative solutions.
Experience with technology transition planning, including coordination between R&D organizations and operational end-users.
Knowledge of DHS Component (CBP, USCG, ICE) operational requirements and capability gaps in the maritime domain.
Experience with autonomous maritime systems, unmanned platforms, remote sensing technologies, or maritime environmental monitoring systems.
Familiarity with federal acquisition processes, including Broad Agency Announcements (BAAs), Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs), grants, and cooperative agreements.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
Experience with data analytics tools and methodologies for portfolio analysis and decision support.
Active Top Secret clearance and current DHS Suitability are strongly preferred.
Ability to work in a dynamic team-oriented environment, demonstrate teamwork and initiative, and function productively in the face of new assignments and the re-prioritization of existing assignments and processes.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and at pace with senior executives, rapidly translating strategic direction into actionable plans and delivered products.

Overview

Noblis and our wholly owned subsidiaries, Noblis ESI and Noblis MSD, take on some of the nation’s toughest challenges, delivering advanced solutions to our customers’ most critical missions. We bring together leading scientific, engineering, and management expertise in a culture grounded in objectivity and collaboration, ensuring our work creates lasting impact across federal missions.

We work with a broad range of government agencies in the defense, intelligence, and federal civilian sectors. Learn more and find opportunities at careers.noblis.org

jobs.title: Principal, Strategy and Operations Manager - GBSG U.S. Marketing
jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a mission-driven, global financial platform company that gives everyone the opportunity to prosper. We do this by using technology to solve our customers’ most important problems. We serve customers by finding more ways to put more money in their pockets, eliminating work and drudgery so they can focus on their lives and what matters to them, and ensuring that every financial decision that they make, they make it with confidence. We are also at an important point in Intuit’s transformation, as AI and human intelligence reshape both the experiences we deliver for customers and how we operate. Across GBSG, that means making sharper choices about where we invest, how we grow, and how we move with greater speed and focus.

As a Principal Strategy and Operations Manager, you will sit at the center of Commercial Operations, the connective tissue between strategy and execution across the commercial organization. You'll own the planning rhythm, drive the initiatives that unlock growth and profitability, and turn ambiguous business problems into decisions leadership can act on. Working at the intersection of business strategy, data analysis, and AI-enabled operations, you'll partner closely with finance, marketing, sales, and product to translate priorities into measurable outcomes and to build the operating cadence that keeps them on track. Be part of a high-growth environment where your contributions have direct, visible impact. We are looking for a strategic operator who is an avid learner, experimenter, and builder, ready to rewire how Commercial Operations runs in the AI era.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Execution: Develop and execute key business initiatives to drive growth and profitability. Own and evolve the quarterly and annual planning process, helping leaders make explicit choices about priorities, investments, tradeoffs and sequencing. Use AI-assisted tools to compress cycle time and get to decisions faster.
Project Management and Cross-functional Collaboration: Manage strategic initiatives from conception to execution, collaborating with finance, marketing, sales, and product teams to ensure alignment and effective implementation. Identify and drive mitigation strategies, prioritize initiatives, and ensure alignment with cross-functional leaders to assess effectiveness and make necessary adjustments.
Performance and Data Analysis: Identify and recommend improvements to processes and systems, conducting in-depth analyses of business performance, market trends, and operational metrics to enhance efficiency and inform strategic decisions. Use AI and automation to expand the scope and speed of analysis, and to automate recurring reporting so effort shifts from data assembly to insight.
Executive Communication: Shape executive decisions by distilling complex analysis and data into clear recommendations, alternatives, and tradeoffs. Communicate those insights through crisp presentations, written narratives, and other executive-ready materials that create the clarity and alignment leaders need to make decisions and move.
AI Enablement and Velocity: Bring a demonstrated track record of using AI to meaningfully increase personal and team throughput. Design changes that address root causes rather than adding another process or layer.

Qualifications

This role demands a blend of analytical prowess, operational expertise, and leadership skills to drive effective business strategies and operational efficiencies in a complex and evolving environment.

7+ years of experience in strategy consulting, business operations, or a related field, ideally with experience in management consulting or large technology companies.
Experience leading multi-year strategy and planning, including long-range planning, annual planning, scenario development, and translating strategy into operating priorities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data analysis, financial modeling, and KPI trend analysis. Proficiency in SQL, Python or similar for data analysis and automation scripting; experience with no‑code/low‑code platforms (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code); a plus.
Track record of working cross‑functionally with product, engineering, data scientists, and marketing channel owners. Understanding of marketing measurement, incrementality testing, and performance metrics.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to develop clear and impactful reports and presentations for stakeholders. Demonstrated leadership abilities with experience influencing and building partnerships across all levels of an organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, high-growth environment with ambiguity.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Finance, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field; advanced degree such as an MBA preferred.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $197,000 - $266,000

San Diego, CA $196,000- $265,000

8-12+ years of experience in strategic program management, business transformation, strategy & operations, or a related field.

Expertise in triaging complex issues, conducting root cause analysis, and utilizing competitive intelligence.

jobs.description:
JOIN THE ROSENBAUER TEAM

At Rosenbauer, our culture is rooted in integrity, teamwork, community, and an unwavering commitment to safety and excellence. We value people first, creating a workplace where employees are supported, respected, and empowered to grow. If you’re inspired by meaningful work, motivated by shared goals, and driven by a passion to make a real difference, you’ll find a place to thrive here.

About The Role

The Dealer Development Analyst will play a highly visible role within Rosenbauer America, providing insights and recommendations that influence strategic decisions across the dealer network. Analysis, findings, and performance recommendations developed in this role will be routinely presented to senior leadership and shared with the company's Board of Directors.

What You’ll Do

All employees are required to support Rosenbauer’s Mission, Vision, and Values. The following are the essential duties of this position and do not include marginal functions that are incidental to the performance of fundamental job duties. The scope and duties of a given position may change or be temporarily altered based on the business needs of Rosenbauer.

Dealer Performance Analysis:
Monitor and evaluate dealer sales, service, and operational performance across the dealer network by reviewing key performance indicators, dashboards, and scorecards. Analyze trends in sales growth, market share, service revenue, profitability, and overall business performance to identify both opportunities and areas requiring improvement.

Dealer Development and Improvement Planning:
Identify high-performing and underperforming dealers through detailed performance assessments and root cause analysis. Develop actionable recommendations, support dealer improvement initiatives, and collaborate with Regional Sales Managers to enhance dealer capabilities, performance, and long-term business success.

Network Optimization and Market Evaluation:
Assess dealer network coverage and market penetration to identify gaps, expansion opportunities, and strategic growth initiatives. Support the evaluation of new dealer candidates, dealership acquisitions, territory adjustments, and network optimization efforts to strengthen market presence and customer support capabilities.

Performance Tracking and Accountability:
Monitor dealer action plans, improvement strategies, and development objectives to ensure progress toward organizational goals. Track results against established performance targets and provide ongoing follow-up to support successful execution of agreed-upon initiatives.

Operational and Service Performance Management:
Analyze warranty claims, customer service metrics, operational effectiveness, and other performance indicators to identify risks, improve customer satisfaction, and enhance dealer operational efficiency. Recommend process improvements that drive stronger dealer performance and customer support outcomes.

Data Management and Reporting:
Gather, validate, and analyze data from multiple internal systems and business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and consistency. Develop reports, dashboards, scorecards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights into dealer performance and business trends.

Executive Reporting and Presentation Development:
Prepare executive summaries, leadership reports, and professional presentations that clearly communicate key performance trends, business risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations. Support leadership meetings and Board of Directors reviews with accurate, data-driven analyses and presentation materials.

Strategic Analysis and Business Case Development:
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and strategic evaluations that support organizational growth initiatives. Develop business cases, return-on-investment analyses, and financial justifications for dealer development programs, investments, and incentive initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with Sales, Service, Operations, and Leadership teams to support business objectives, strategic initiatives, and dealer network performance. Participate in cross-functional meetings to align priorities, share insights, and coordinate actions that support company growth and operational excellence.

Incentive Program Administration:
Monitor dealer incentive and rebate programs to ensure proper execution, performance tracking, and alignment with business objectives. Evaluate program effectiveness and support the development of business cases that maximize dealer engagement and organizational return on investment.

Risk Assessment and Strategic Planning:
Identify and evaluate risks impacting dealer performance, customer satisfaction, market expansion, and overall business growth. Maintain dealer profiles, performance records, and strategic planning documentation while supporting dealer network growth, optimization, and long-term strategic planning initiatives.

Leadership Communication and Recommendations:
Present findings, insights, and recommendations to organizational leadership in a clear and concise manner. Deliver data-driven conclusions and strategic guidance that support informed decision-making and continuous improvement across the dealer network.

Other Duties as Assigned:
Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required to support departmental objectives and organizational needs. Maintain flexibility and adaptability to address changing priorities and business requirements. Assist in evaluating potential dealer additions, expansions, acquisitions, or territory changes.

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Knowledge, Education, And/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Finance, or related field.
3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or sales operations required.
5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or sales operations preferred.
Experience in manufacturing, dealer networks, or field sales required.
Previous experience using reporting packages (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) databases (SQL based ERP System-Sage 500), advanced Excel and programming required.

Able to follow written and verbal directions and communicate new information that could affect project trajectories.

Math

Able to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, and percentages.

Computer

Able to perform intermediate PC functions and Microsoft Office Suite.

Abilities

Strong attention to detail.

Able to prioritize work and multitask while adhering to deadlines.
