new_jobs.description:
Summary

As the Physical Security Manager, you will be the foundational lead for our physical protection strategy. We are looking for a builder who can transition our current informal processes into a robust, scalable, and technology-driven security program. You will own the entire lifecycle of physical security—from conducting initial risk assessments and selecting vendors to implementing enterprise-grade access control systems and fostering a culture of safety across our multi-city footprint.

Key Responsibilities

System Implementation & Operationalization: Select and project-manage the deployment of a unified, cloud-based Access Control (ACS) and Visitor Management System (VMS) across all 5 offices.
Hardening & Risk Assessment: Conduct comprehensive Physical Security Risk Assessments (PSRA) for all sites. Identify vulnerabilities and implement physical hardening measures (ballistic glass, reinforced entries, etc.).
Emergency Preparedness: Author and maintain all Emergency Action Plans (EAPs). Lead tabletop exercises and floor warden training for fire, life safety, and active threat scenarios.
Asset Protection & Disposal (Hardware & IP): Design and enforce protocols to secure and destroy, at end of life, Sensitive Proprietary Information and IT Hardware.
Security Culture & Awareness: Develop and launch an Anti-Tailgating Awareness Program. Transition the company culture from "passive politeness" to "active security" through training and social engineering testing.
Executive Protection & Threat Assessment: Conduct bespoke Threat Assessments for Executive Team (ET) members, evaluating their public-facing risk profiles, residential security, and travel safety.

Required Qualifications And Key Competencies

8 + years of progressive experience in corporate security management, with a demonstrable track record of building and scaling physical security programs from "ground zero" in high-growth technology or financial services environments.
Expert-level proficiency in selecting, procuring, and implementing enterprise-grade, cloud-native Access Control (ACS) and Video Management Systems (VMS), specifically integrating these with HRIS and Identity Providers.
Deep experience navigating physical security audits for SOC2 Type II, PCI-DSS, or ISO 27001, ensuring all physical controls are documented, tested, and evidence-ready.
Mastery of threat assessment methodologies to conduct Executive Team (ET) risk profiles, residential assessments, and bespoke protection plans for high-profile leadership.
Ability to design and facilitate sophisticated tabletop exercises and emergency response simulations for senior leadership, bridging the gap between physical safety and business continuity.
Sophisticated negotiation and management skills for third-party service providers, including global security integrators and contract guarding services, with a focus on Zero-Trust physical access models.
Influential Communication: Exceptional "soft skills" with the ability to build a security-first culture without introducing unnecessary friction; able to translate complex physical risks into business-impact language for C-Suite stakeholders.
Proficient in establishing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and security metrics to provide the board with transparent reporting on program ROI and site vulnerability trends.
A self-starter who thrives in "immature" program environments, possessing the agility to pivot from high-level strategic planning to on-site technical troubleshooting.
Unwavering commitment to confidentiality and ethical conduct, particularly when handling sensitive information regarding Executive Team safety and proprietary fintech IP.
A preference for modern, frictionless security solutions over traditional, bureaucratic "gatekeeping" models environments.
Willingness and ability to travel once per quarter for team meetings, trainings, or business needs.

Topstep is an engaging working environment that ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration by keeping cameras on during meetings and maintaining a robust Slack environment for communication.

Collect and maintain data needed to meet system cybersecurity reporting requirements IAW cybersecurity law, regulation, and policy

Participate in network and systems design to ensure implementation of appropriate systems security policies

Bachelor's or master's degree in a related field and at least three (3) years of experience in the respective technical/professional discipline being performed, three (3) of which must be in the DoW/DoD

Experience with AF computer networking concepts and protocols, network security methodologies, cybersecurity principles used to manage risk, and experience identifying and mitigating system vulnerabilities is required.

Prior experience working with Chinese regulators or cross-border data transfer assessments.

new_jobs.title: Principal, Strategy and Operations Manager - GBSG U.S. Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a mission-driven, global financial platform company that gives everyone the opportunity to prosper. We do this by using technology to solve our customers’ most important problems. We serve customers by finding more ways to put more money in their pockets, eliminating work and drudgery so they can focus on their lives and what matters to them, and ensuring that every financial decision that they make, they make it with confidence. We are also at an important point in Intuit’s transformation, as AI and human intelligence reshape both the experiences we deliver for customers and how we operate. Across GBSG, that means making sharper choices about where we invest, how we grow, and how we move with greater speed and focus.

As a Principal Strategy and Operations Manager, you will sit at the center of Commercial Operations, the connective tissue between strategy and execution across the commercial organization. You'll own the planning rhythm, drive the initiatives that unlock growth and profitability, and turn ambiguous business problems into decisions leadership can act on. Working at the intersection of business strategy, data analysis, and AI-enabled operations, you'll partner closely with finance, marketing, sales, and product to translate priorities into measurable outcomes and to build the operating cadence that keeps them on track. Be part of a high-growth environment where your contributions have direct, visible impact. We are looking for a strategic operator who is an avid learner, experimenter, and builder, ready to rewire how Commercial Operations runs in the AI era.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Execution: Develop and execute key business initiatives to drive growth and profitability. Own and evolve the quarterly and annual planning process, helping leaders make explicit choices about priorities, investments, tradeoffs and sequencing. Use AI-assisted tools to compress cycle time and get to decisions faster.
Project Management and Cross-functional Collaboration: Manage strategic initiatives from conception to execution, collaborating with finance, marketing, sales, and product teams to ensure alignment and effective implementation. Identify and drive mitigation strategies, prioritize initiatives, and ensure alignment with cross-functional leaders to assess effectiveness and make necessary adjustments.
Performance and Data Analysis: Identify and recommend improvements to processes and systems, conducting in-depth analyses of business performance, market trends, and operational metrics to enhance efficiency and inform strategic decisions. Use AI and automation to expand the scope and speed of analysis, and to automate recurring reporting so effort shifts from data assembly to insight.
Executive Communication: Shape executive decisions by distilling complex analysis and data into clear recommendations, alternatives, and tradeoffs. Communicate those insights through crisp presentations, written narratives, and other executive-ready materials that create the clarity and alignment leaders need to make decisions and move.
AI Enablement and Velocity: Bring a demonstrated track record of using AI to meaningfully increase personal and team throughput. Design changes that address root causes rather than adding another process or layer.

Qualifications

This role demands a blend of analytical prowess, operational expertise, and leadership skills to drive effective business strategies and operational efficiencies in a complex and evolving environment.

7+ years of experience in strategy consulting, business operations, or a related field, ideally with experience in management consulting or large technology companies.
Experience leading multi-year strategy and planning, including long-range planning, annual planning, scenario development, and translating strategy into operating priorities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data analysis, financial modeling, and KPI trend analysis. Proficiency in SQL, Python or similar for data analysis and automation scripting; experience with no‑code/low‑code platforms (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code); a plus.
Track record of working cross‑functionally with product, engineering, data scientists, and marketing channel owners. Understanding of marketing measurement, incrementality testing, and performance metrics.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to develop clear and impactful reports and presentations for stakeholders. Demonstrated leadership abilities with experience influencing and building partnerships across all levels of an organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, high-growth environment with ambiguity.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Finance, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field; advanced degree such as an MBA preferred.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $197,000 - $266,000

San Diego, CA $196,000- $265,000

new_jobs.description:
JOIN THE ROSENBAUER TEAM

At Rosenbauer, our culture is rooted in integrity, teamwork, community, and an unwavering commitment to safety and excellence. We value people first, creating a workplace where employees are supported, respected, and empowered to grow. If you’re inspired by meaningful work, motivated by shared goals, and driven by a passion to make a real difference, you’ll find a place to thrive here.

About The Role

The Dealer Development Analyst will play a highly visible role within Rosenbauer America, providing insights and recommendations that influence strategic decisions across the dealer network. Analysis, findings, and performance recommendations developed in this role will be routinely presented to senior leadership and shared with the company's Board of Directors.

What You’ll Do

All employees are required to support Rosenbauer’s Mission, Vision, and Values. The following are the essential duties of this position and do not include marginal functions that are incidental to the performance of fundamental job duties. The scope and duties of a given position may change or be temporarily altered based on the business needs of Rosenbauer.

Dealer Performance Analysis:
Monitor and evaluate dealer sales, service, and operational performance across the dealer network by reviewing key performance indicators, dashboards, and scorecards. Analyze trends in sales growth, market share, service revenue, profitability, and overall business performance to identify both opportunities and areas requiring improvement.

Dealer Development and Improvement Planning:
Identify high-performing and underperforming dealers through detailed performance assessments and root cause analysis. Develop actionable recommendations, support dealer improvement initiatives, and collaborate with Regional Sales Managers to enhance dealer capabilities, performance, and long-term business success.

Network Optimization and Market Evaluation:
Assess dealer network coverage and market penetration to identify gaps, expansion opportunities, and strategic growth initiatives. Support the evaluation of new dealer candidates, dealership acquisitions, territory adjustments, and network optimization efforts to strengthen market presence and customer support capabilities.

Performance Tracking and Accountability:
Monitor dealer action plans, improvement strategies, and development objectives to ensure progress toward organizational goals. Track results against established performance targets and provide ongoing follow-up to support successful execution of agreed-upon initiatives.

Operational and Service Performance Management:
Analyze warranty claims, customer service metrics, operational effectiveness, and other performance indicators to identify risks, improve customer satisfaction, and enhance dealer operational efficiency. Recommend process improvements that drive stronger dealer performance and customer support outcomes.

Data Management and Reporting:
Gather, validate, and analyze data from multiple internal systems and business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and consistency. Develop reports, dashboards, scorecards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights into dealer performance and business trends.

Executive Reporting and Presentation Development:
Prepare executive summaries, leadership reports, and professional presentations that clearly communicate key performance trends, business risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations. Support leadership meetings and Board of Directors reviews with accurate, data-driven analyses and presentation materials.

Strategic Analysis and Business Case Development:
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and strategic evaluations that support organizational growth initiatives. Develop business cases, return-on-investment analyses, and financial justifications for dealer development programs, investments, and incentive initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with Sales, Service, Operations, and Leadership teams to support business objectives, strategic initiatives, and dealer network performance. Participate in cross-functional meetings to align priorities, share insights, and coordinate actions that support company growth and operational excellence.

Incentive Program Administration:
Monitor dealer incentive and rebate programs to ensure proper execution, performance tracking, and alignment with business objectives. Evaluate program effectiveness and support the development of business cases that maximize dealer engagement and organizational return on investment.

Risk Assessment and Strategic Planning:
Identify and evaluate risks impacting dealer performance, customer satisfaction, market expansion, and overall business growth. Maintain dealer profiles, performance records, and strategic planning documentation while supporting dealer network growth, optimization, and long-term strategic planning initiatives.

Leadership Communication and Recommendations:
Present findings, insights, and recommendations to organizational leadership in a clear and concise manner. Deliver data-driven conclusions and strategic guidance that support informed decision-making and continuous improvement across the dealer network.

Other Duties as Assigned:
Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required to support departmental objectives and organizational needs. Maintain flexibility and adaptability to address changing priorities and business requirements. Assist in evaluating potential dealer additions, expansions, acquisitions, or territory changes.

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Finance, or related field.
3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or sales operations required.
5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or sales operations preferred.
Experience in manufacturing, dealer networks, or field sales required.
Previous experience using reporting packages (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) databases (SQL based ERP System-Sage 500), advanced Excel and programming required.

Able to follow written and verbal directions and communicate new information that could affect project trajectories.

You are a security-focused technology professional with expertise in information security, vulnerability management, threat detection, and risk mitigation. You have a proven ability to partner with technical and business teams to strengthen security controls, lead incident response and threat hunting activities, and ensure compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. Your experience includes improving security monitoring, managing vulnerabilities, evaluating security solutions, supporting audits, and driving secure configuration and change management practices. You are passionate about protecting sensitive information, mentoring teams, and delivering practical, business-aligned security strategies that reduce risk while enabling innovation.

What You'll Do

Lead ongoing vulnerability management activities and identification of potential threats. Coordinate and direct technology staff in the identification and remediation of system vulnerabilities across the computing environment. Escalate any immediate and severe issues accordingly to the attention of the Manager – Information Security and appropriate reporting to senior leadership.
Maintain, improve, and develop vendor supported and customized organizational processes supporting information security monitoring of asset, patch, network, vulnerability, change and configuration management.
Prepares for and participates in threat hunting and security incident response activities. This includes working with Golden 1 IT and Information support teams to develop response readiness.

Define and evaluate functional requirements and specifications of security systems for both internal and external business environments.

Monitor, measure, test and report on the effectiveness and efficiency of information security controls as well as compliance with information security policies and procedure.
Recommend new security solutions as well as effective improvements to existing security controls that do not negatively impact business innovation.
Train colleagues on new Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTP) of cyber-attacks and mentor junior teammates.

Work with internal and external auditors during examinations providing support and assistance in addressing audit recommendations.

5+ years hands on experience in the management, configuration, administration, installation, and evaluation of network or operating systems software (Microsoft, Linux desired), hardware and applications required
3+ years experience in organizational information security, information assurance or providing security consulting services required

new_jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description

At Regions, the Risk Information Technology and Data Analyst is a key member of the IT and Data Risk Management organization and performs general activities consistent with the second line of defense, including IT and Data risk identification, measurement, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting. This position supports the implementation of Regions’ Risk Management Framework aligned with regulatory expectations (FFIEC, NIST, GLBA) and internal policies. The analyst collaborates with Technology, Cyber Security, Data and Analytics, Compliance, Business Risk Teams, and Internal Audit to proactively manage IT and Data risks.

Primary Responsibilities

Leads IT and Data Risk Targeted Risk Assessments, Continuous Monitoring, and Testing as identified across all aspects of Information Technology and Data, including application development, cyber security, enterprise architecture, business continuity and disaster recovery, data governance, data quality, and change management, etc
Performs core risk assessments, including the enterprise risk assessment, payment network attestations, and the cyber security risk assessment which evaluates the company’s compliance with key regulatory requirements
Performs gap assessments to evaluate the design and effectiveness of technology and data controls aligned to regulatory and industry requirements
Reviews and validates risk analysis work completed by junior team members
Creates and revises IT and Data Risk Management methodology, including procedures
Monitors trends and regulatory changes in IT and Data and advises leadership on technology and data initiatives that support these trends
Reviews IT and Data policies and standards to ensure they align with regulations and industry best practices.
Monitors, tracks, validates, and reports mitigation and resolution of IT and Data risk issues
Develops and produces reporting to effectively communicate key risks, findings, and recommendations for improvement and participates in discussions of results with key stakeholders
Performs annual planning, including staffing assessments and identifying training opportunities
Supports exam readiness for regulatory and audit examinations including providing risk insights, collecting evidence, and preparing verbal and written materials
Forms and maintains effective partnerships with key stakeholders within strategic business groups and technology to provide credible challenge of Technology and Data’s execution of the risk management framework
Provides day to day guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and helps build risk awareness across technology, data, and business functions

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in related field
Five (5) years of relevant experience in IT risk, IT audit, technology, cybersecurity, or operational risk
Strong understanding of risk management, cybersecurity/technology, and compliance principles

Preferences

Certifications (e.g., Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Public Accountant (CPA))
Experience in a financial institution or public accounting
Experience with GRC tools (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow)
Strong understanding of key banking regulations and industry standards (e.g., FFIEC, GLBA, NIST).
Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to translate technical risks for business audiences.

Skills And Competencies

Ability to adapt to quickly changing environments
Ability to build effective partnerships
Ability to mentor and guide less experienced team members
Ability to research, analyze data, and derive facts
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Proficiency with Microsoft Products (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Teams, Visio, SharePoint) and ability to learn additional systems as needed
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal, written communication, and organizational skills
Strong work ethic and self-motivation

Position Type

Full time

Compensation Details

Other factors which directly impact pay for individual associates include: experience, skills, knowledge, contribution, job location and, most importantly, performance in the job role. As these factors vary by individuals, pay will also vary among individual associates within the same job.

Join us in shaping the future of Regina's Recreation and Cultural Services department as a Market Research Analyst. As a valued member of our team, you'll have access to a supportive work environment, professional development opportunities, and the chance to make meaningful connections with colleagues who share your passion for excellence.

The role will be responsible for developing, designing, implementing and measuring the City of Regina’s leisure, cultural and community development related marketing. This position will also be required to perform a variety of primary and secondary source data collection and analysis to inform marketing and policy decisions. This position reports to the Coordinator, Business Services.

Develop or direct the production of traditional and electronic marketing products for the Recreation & Cultural Services department’s leisure, culture and social development programs.
Manage the Culture, Social Development and Recreation sections of the City of Regina website.
Develop and implement the Recreation & Cultural Services Department’s social media output with the Communications team.
Analyze and interpret market and customer data to assist in the development of arts, culture and leisure programming.
Analyze and interpret market and customer data to assist in the development of program and facility fees.
Facilitate discussions among Department staff to interpret research results and apply the results for program and service planning and design.
Oversee the work of related contractors and suppliers.
Vendor and Procurement Management
Perform related work as required.

Key Qualifications

Successful completion of a University degree or diploma in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in developing or directing the creation of traditional, non-traditional, web-based, and social media marketing.
Expert interpersonal and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team setting.
Skilled in the usage of Management Software (Customer, Sales, Industry Specific) to retrieve and analyze data to provide information for decision making and evaluation purposes.
Skilled in Word, Excel, Power Point, Teams, SharePoint.
Skilled in the management of multiple projects and prioritization of tasks to meet established deadlines.
Proficient in project management
Proficient in the use or direction of the use of graphic design programs such as Illustrator, Photo Shop and In Design.
Proficient in contract management and procurement
Proficient in the development and direction of corporate Social Media (Facebook,Twitter and Instagram) Proficient in quantitatively and qualitatively measuring the efficacy of traditional, non-traditional, web-based, and social media products.
Demonstrated ability to effectively express ideas and concepts orally and in writing across diverse audiences and circumstances.

new_jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description

At Regions, the Risk Information Technology and Data Analyst is a key member of the IT and Data Risk Management organization and performs general activities consistent with the second line of defense, including IT and Data risk identification, measurement, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting. This position supports the implementation of Regions’ Risk Management Framework aligned with regulatory expectations (FFIEC, NIST, GLBA) and internal policies. The analyst collaborates with Technology, Cyber Security, Data and Analytics, Compliance, Business Risk Teams, and Internal Audit to proactively manage IT and Data risks.

Primary Responsibilities

Leads IT and Data Risk Targeted Risk Assessments, Continuous Monitoring, and Testing as identified across all aspects of Information Technology and Data, including application development, cyber security, enterprise architecture, business continuity and disaster recovery, data governance, data quality, and change management, etc
Performs core risk assessments, including the enterprise risk assessment, payment network attestations, and the cyber security risk assessment which evaluates the company’s compliance with key regulatory requirements
Performs gap assessments to evaluate the design and effectiveness of technology and data controls aligned to regulatory and industry requirements
Reviews and validates risk analysis work completed by junior team members
Creates and revises IT and Data Risk Management methodology, including procedures
Monitors trends and regulatory changes in IT and Data and advises leadership on technology and data initiatives that support these trends
Reviews IT and Data policies and standards to ensure they align with regulations and industry best practices.
Monitors, tracks, validates, and reports mitigation and resolution of IT and Data risk issues
Develops and produces reporting to effectively communicate key risks, findings, and recommendations for improvement and participates in discussions of results with key stakeholders
Performs annual planning, including staffing assessments and identifying training opportunities
Supports exam readiness for regulatory and audit examinations including providing risk insights, collecting evidence, and preparing verbal and written materials
Forms and maintains effective partnerships with key stakeholders within strategic business groups and technology to provide credible challenge of Technology and Data’s execution of the risk management framework
Provides day to day guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and helps build risk awareness across technology, data, and business functions

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in related field
Five (5) years of relevant experience in IT risk, IT audit, technology, cybersecurity, or operational risk
Strong understanding of risk management, cybersecurity/technology, and compliance principles

Preferences

Certifications (e.g., Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified Public Accountant (CPA))
Experience in a financial institution or public accounting
Experience with GRC tools (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow)
Strong understanding of key banking regulations and industry standards (e.g., FFIEC, GLBA, NIST).
Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to translate technical risks for business audiences.

Skills And Competencies

Ability to adapt to quickly changing environments
Ability to build effective partnerships
Ability to mentor and guide less experienced team members
Ability to research, analyze data, and derive facts
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Proficiency with Microsoft Products (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Teams, Visio, SharePoint) and ability to learn additional systems as needed
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal, written communication, and organizational skills
Strong work ethic and self-motivation

Full time

Program Manager - Products & Services Privacy

Job Summary

This role is responsible for leading and managing privacy projects and enable the HP Products & Services organizations in meeting global privacy, data protection, AI governance, and regulatory compliance obligations. The Program Manager serves as the operational backbone of the privacy organization, driving program execution, portfolio management, stakeholder engagement, project governance, reporting, and continuous process improvement.

The role partners closely with Privacy Advisors, Legal, Engineering, Product Management, Security, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to ensure privacy initiatives are prioritized, tracked, communicated, and delivered effectively. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in program management, cross-functional coordination, executive reporting, operational excellence, and organizational change management.

Success in this role requires balancing multiple initiatives, driving accountability across stakeholders, identifying and mitigating risks, and ensuring leadership has visibility into program health, compliance readiness, and strategic priorities.

Program & Portfolio Management

Manage a portfolio of privacy initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, resource availability, and regulatory commitments.
Develop and maintain program roadmaps, project plans, milestones, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
Establish and drive project governance structures, operating rhythms, and reporting mechanisms.
Ensure initiatives progress according to established timelines and proactively address obstacles, risks, and resource constraints.
Coordinate activities across multiple workstreams, teams, and business units to ensure successful execution.

Identify opportunities to streamline privacy operations through standardization, automation, and process improvements.

Establish consistent methodologies for project intake, prioritization, status reporting, and resource management.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

The Opportunity

Abbott is hiring a Sarbanes-Oxley Finance Program Manager to work out of our Abbott Park
location. This Sarbanes-Oxley (Sox) Program Management Office (PMO) position will oversee and serve as the primary PMO contact and resource for management within various Divisions and Corporate functions who are responsible for completion of Sox program activities and will provide ongoing support and guidance. The position will also have significant interaction with other financial and IT management across the Divisions and Corporate functions, and with Abbott's external and internal auditors.

This position manages financial aspects Abbott’s program for compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley Section 404, which requires Divisions and Corporate functions to maintain, document and test internal controls over financial reporting. This position will lead or assist with Program Management Office functions including : program planning, scoping and scheduling; communication with divisions and Corporate functions; updating and developing program tools and processes; assisting with Division Sox planning and training activities; monitoring of program status and schedule; management and resolution of issues; review of internal control deficiencies; providing guidance for the evaluation and remediation of deficiencies; monitoring of remediation activities; and determination of readiness for review by internal and external auditors.

What You’ll Work On

Ensure quality of Division work (for selected Divisions and Corporate functions) and compliance with Abbott Sox program standards.
Manage program schedule to ensure deliverables are met (includes Division deliverables to PMO and PMO deliverables to auditors).
Review completed internal control documentation, evaluate testing results, review ratings and conclusions. Review, evaluate and prioritize deficiencies. Communicate expectations for remediation of deficiencies and monitor and manage remediation efforts as appropriate.
Provide functional leadership and comprehensive ongoing support to Division Sarbanes Managers for the completion of Abbott Sarbanes Oxley Section 404 and 302 requirements. In addition, serve as primary Division resource for technical guidance on Section 404 requirements.
Complete annual Divisional and Corporate function scoping activities in a timely and thorough manner. Identify and analyze all relevant matters that could impact Sox scope and propose related approaches (during annual scoping and ongoing). Obtain Division, PMO and senior management approvals on proposed scope as appropriate and document conclusions.
Determine the Sox scope impact of changes to financial processes and IT systems including those resulting from business combinations and other organizational changes.
Complete ad hoc analysis and reviews of internal controls within Divisions and Corporate functions as necessary.
Complete documentation and testing of Abbott’s Corporate Control Environment.

Required Qualifications

This position requires a minimum of 8-10 years progressive financial experience.
Auditing experience is required.
Candidates must have strong interpersonal communication and leadership skills and the ability to interact with senior financial management.
Candidates must be able to manage multiple tasks and work in a dynamic environment.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
CPA preferred.

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives :
www.abbottbenefits.com

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

new_jobs.title: FTZ Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The FTZ Program Manager leads the continuous improvement, compliance, and long-term effectiveness of Rockwell Automation's Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) program. You will provide strategic oversight of FTZ operations across North America, with a focus on regulatory compliance, external partnership management, audit readiness, program optimization and longterm effectiveness of the program. You will work with company partners, Managed Service Providers, software vendors, and regulatory bodies to ensure FTZ operations are compliant, efficient, scalable, and aligned with our goals. You will be an important liaison with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), FTZ Boards, grantees, and external auditors, while driving sustainable improvements to processes, and governance. You will report to the Trade Compliance Manager for North America and you will be remote.

Your Responsibilities

Lead the FTZ continuous improvement agenda, driving enhancements to compliance quality, process efficiency, system stability, and cost avoidance.
Implement improvement projects based on regulatory changes, audit findings, health checks, and business growth.
Oversee develop, implement, and maintenance standardized FTZ processes, procedures, controls, manuals, and governance frameworks.
Measure FTZ performance metrics, risks, and recommended improvements to leadership.
Provide subject matter leadership on FTZ regulatory requirements, including 19 CFR, 15 CFR, and CBP guidance.
Ensure ongoing compliance with FTZ regulations and proactive identification and mitigation of compliance risks.
Oversee annual systems reviews, reconciliations, and regulatory filings, including preparation of required reports to CBP and zone grantees.
Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting FTZs and ensure communication and implementation.
Lead internal and external FTZ audits, CBP compliance reviews, and independent compliance health checks.
Be the primary contact for regulators, auditors, and external reviewers.
Oversee corrective action plans, validate remediation effectiveness, and ensure sustainable resolution of findings.
Support investigations and compliance assessments, making recommendations for program improvements.
Manage strategic relationships with FTZ Managed Service Providers, software providers, consultants, and advisors.
Oversee thirdparty FTZ performance to ensure service quality, compliance, and agreement on Rockwell Automation expectations.
Partner crossfunctionally with Trade Compliance, Logistics, Finance, IT, Operations, Legal, and Departments on FTZrelated programs.
Support business projects including new zone implementations, expansions, product moves, and distribution strategy changes.
Be the FTZ program ambassador by providing training, guidance, and awareness to company partners.
Prepare and deliver clear, executivelevel communications and presentations related to FTZ compliance and program performance.

The Essentials - You Will Have

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Years of Relevant Work Experience.
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
The ability to travel 10% of the time.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

10+ years of experience in Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) programs or U.S. trade compliance.
Demonstrated experience working with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), FTZ Boards, and zone grantees.
Experience managing thirdparty service providers or Managed Service Providers.
Experience with FTZ inventory control and recordkeeping systems.
Experience leading continuous improvement projects and managing compliance programs.
Experience leading external audits, CBP compliance reviews, and compliance health checks.
Project management experience supporting complex, crossfunctional projects.
Knowledge of import/export regulations, international transportation, and supply chain operations.
Experience with CTPAT or other trade security programs.
Licensed U.S. Customs Broker.

What We Offer

Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
401k
Paid Time off
Parental and Caregiver Leave
Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com.

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans.

If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.

Who We Are

At Newrez, we bring big thinkers and caring doers together to make home happen. We’re a team built on heart and hustle, united by a commitment to show up for our customers, our communities, and each other. We believe that when our people thrive, homeowners thrive - and that’s why we invest in your growth, wellbeing, and ability to make an impact.

Every day, we work to exceed the expectations of our residential mortgage borrowers and business partners through superior service, simple processes, and clear communication. We do this by empowering our employees, encouraging innovative solutions and recognizing great performance.

Primary Function

The Business Analyst - Default Systems & Support will play a key role in the support of various departments in default, including Foreclosure, Bankruptcy, Property Preservation, and Post-Foreclosure. The Business Analyst- Default Systems & Support’s primary objective is to optimize the utilization of key business workflow software such as Black Knight LoanSphere, Tableau, and other various workflow systems. The Business Analyst- Default Systems & Support will analyze system configuration and existing business rules, gather requirements from the business unit, and design and help implement solutions including workflow changes and automation. They will have strong organizational and problem-solving skills as well as the ability to clearly communicate technical items with both technical and non-technical team members.

Principal Duties

Collaborate with the business unit, IT business partners, other internal departments, and external firms to optimize system utilization.
Create reports and assist the business units with ad hoc data.
Proactively analyze and identify system enhancements to streamline workflow processes and improve efficiencies.
Manage a project list, analyze appropriate prioritization based on cost benefit analysis, and conduct prioritization meetings with business unit management team.
Create and clearly communicate detailed technical requirements to IT partners as well as to non-technical team members and management.
Development of process flows, job aids, and procedures relative to foreclosure, bankruptcy, property preservation, and post-foreclosure processes.
Act as a subject matter expert for system troubleshooting and running and creating oversight reporting as well as implementing system enhancements Performs additional projects and duties as assigned by supervisor.
Create, manage, and oversee ongoing enhancements of automation relative to default workflows systems.
Performs related duties as assigned by management.

Education And Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in technical, quantitative, or analytical discipline is preferred.
1+ years’ experience in mortgage or default servicing is preferred.

Knowledge, Skill, and Ability Requirements

Demonstrated analytical and business communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and an ability to multi-task, respond well to pressure and deadlines, and work well individually and in a collaborative environment.
Strong skills in Excel (charts, formulas, pivots) or other data manipulation software
1+ years of experience with Microsoft SQL
Fast learner – able to assimilate new ideas and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with Tableau is a plus.
Prior work experience with BlackKnight LoanSphere is a plus.
Python programming experience preferred.
Visio and process documentation experience preferred.

Additional Information

While this description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the position’s requirements, it in no way implies/states that these are the only job responsibilities. Management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties and request other duties, as necessary.

All employees are required to have smart phones that meet Company security standards with the ability to install apps such as Microsoft Authenticator. Employment will be contingent on this requirement.

Why Newrez

We’re a great place to work because we invest in what matters: your career, your community, your wellbeing, and your future. Our total rewards package is designed to support your whole self.

Company Benefits

We offer benefits, programs, and perks that support you in every aspect of your life.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Health Savings Account with employer contribution
401(k) Retirement plan with employer match

Torch Technologies

Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. Torch Technologies is seeking a Data Analyst / Data Scientist to join a team developing advanced data processing, workflow automation, visualization, and analytics capabilities supporting the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Ground Test Program. Demonstrated experience developing automated data processing and workflow solutions.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

Business Analyst, Technical Enablement – Where Your Impact Actually Matters

About Practifi (The Real Story)

At Practifi, we build financial technology, but more importantly, we build a place where people enjoy working and genuinely care about each other. In a crowd of fintechs preaching culture, we actually live it—what you see in interviews is what you’ll experience every day. You’ll join a team that solves real problems for real people, together.

The Opportunity (What This Role Really Means)

Our Technical Enablement team is the bridge between what our clients need and what our platform can deliver. As a Business Analyst, you’ll be the voice of the client—leading conversations, translating complex business requirements into clear specifications, and making sure nothing gets lost between “what they asked for” and “what we build.” You’ll work in a paired model alongside Technical Consultants so you can focus on the relationship and requirements side while they focus on the technical build. It’s a structure designed to make everyone better at what they do best.

This isn’t a role that exists in a silo. You’ll talk to anyone you want, contribute to discussions across teams, and see how your work directly impacts our clients’ success. Because when you can trace your daily tasks to real outcomes, work actually feels worthwhile.

Your Day-to-Day (The Honest Version)

The Core Work

Here’s what you’ll actually be doing:

Serve as the primary point of contact for client MSP accounts, managing ongoing communication, timelines, and deliverables so clients always know where things stand.
Lead discovery sessions and client meetings to gather, clarify, and document requirements—translating business needs into clear, actionable specs for the technical team.
Advise clients on standard Practifi functionality versus custom builds, guiding them toward best-practice solutions that maximize value.
Coordinate with Technical Consultants, Client Success, and leadership to keep projects on track and resolve issues before they escalate.

You’ll navigate a learning curve—with a dedicated Practibuddy by your side.
Our documentation is robust, but evolving; feedback is valued.
Curiosity is celebrated—questions are encouraged.
We solve challenges as a team, not in silos.

The Growth Part

Annual Learnbucks stipend for continued education.
Transparent, real promotion pathways—we grow from within.
Direct exposure to leadership and multiple departments.
Space to experiment, fail fast, and innovate.

What We’re Really Looking For

The Must-Haves

3–5 years of experience in a business analyst, requirements analyst, or client-facing consulting role within SaaS, fintech, or professional services.
Demonstrated ability to lead client meetings independently and demonstrate value of technical projects, translating business needs into actionable plans.
Experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred).

The More Important Stuff

Someone who’s comfortable being themselves (pets bombing Zoom calls welcome).
Curiosity about how things work and how they could work better.
Appreciation for transparency (we share everything—pay, challenges, wins).
Collaborative spirit (our Slack channels cover everything from work projects to reality TV).

What Taking This Leap Gets You

The Practical Stuff

Competitive salary: $75,000 – $95,000 (yes, we’re transparent about pay).
20 days paid vacation, 10 days paid sick, 3 paid personal days, 3 paid volunteering days (all annual from day one).
Comprehensive benefits package.
Annual Learnbucks for continued education.

The Cultural Stuff (The Real Reasons People Stay)

Your Practibuddy: Someone dedicated to helping you succeed from day one.
Real Work-Life Integration: Not just a buzzword—we actually mean it with flexibility.
Bi-annual Summits: Chicago gatherings for connection, collaboration, and yes, celebration (trust falls optional).
Genuine Connections: What you see on video calls is what you get in person.
Internal Celebrations: We celebrate big and small wins in Slack and IRL.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Talk to anyone, contribute anywhere.

Living Our Values Daily

Growth: Learnbucks, promotions from within, encouraged skill development.
Collaboration: Cross-functional projects, open communication, mutual support.
Transparency: Open pay scales, honest feedback, regular pulse surveys.
Curiosity: Permission to experiment, questions welcomed, continuous improvement.
Integrity: Real client feedback drives decisions, authentic relationships matter.

Ready to Join Our Community?

This role reports to the Manager, Technical Consulting, and you’ll be working closely with Technical Consultants, Client Success, and cross-functional teams. Start date is flexible, and yes, we’re fully remote with those amazing in-person summits.

One Last Thing: We’re not just hiring a Business Analyst—we’re adding someone to our community. Someone whose perspective will make us better, whose questions will spark innovations, and whose authentic self will fit right in with our perfectly imperfect team.

Sound like your kind of place? Let’s talk.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a results-driven Program Manager to serve as the operational

backbone of our SMB and ISV Cloud Sales Center (CSC) organization. In this role, you will design, launch,

and measure sales campaigns that drive pipeline growth and revenue acceleration across 140+ sellers

spanning multiple districts and segments.

You will own the end-to-end campaign lifecycle — from identifying high-impact sales plays aligned to S-

team priorities, through execution tracking, to closed-loop performance reporting that gives leadership

real-time visibility into what's working and where to double down. You are the force multiplier that

enables 14 District Managers to stay focused on developing sellers and closing deals, while ensuring

strategic initiatives execute with programmatic rigor across the entire business.

This role sits at the intersection of sales strategy, enablement, and operational excellence. You will

partner closely with front-line leaders, cross-functional teams (Partner, Marketing, SA, Product), and

senior leadership to turn high-level goals into actionable, repeatable sales motions that scale

Key job responsibilities

Campaign Design & Launch: Architect and launch sales campaigns/plays (e.g., product-led plays

for Kiro, AgentCore, IPMM; migration plays; partner-sourced plays) with clear targeting criteria, seller

talk tracks, execution timelines, and success metrics.

Closed-Loop Reporting & Mechanisms: Build and maintain campaign performance dashboards

and WBR/MBR reporting mechanisms that track adoption, pipeline created, conversion rates, and

revenue impact at the district and seller level.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the single-threaded owner for coordinating cross-org

initiatives — removing the coordination tax from DMs by driving alignment across Partner, Marketing,

SA, Product, and Enablement teams.

Enablement Content & Playbooks: Develop seller-facing enablement assets (one-pagers, call

guides, objection handling, competitive positioning) that accelerate ramp on new plays and ensure

consistent execution.

Sprint Cadence Management: Own the campaign sprint calendar — defining 2–4 week execution

sprints, facilitating kickoffs, running mid-sprint inspections, and delivering retrospectives with

actionable insights.

Goal Execution Support: Translate S-team goals and leadership priorities into district-level action

plans with clear owners, milestones, and escalation paths.

Performance Analysis & Optimization: Analyze campaign data to identify top-performing plays,

rep-level execution gaps, and segment-specific patterns — then recommend adjustments to improve

outcomes in subsequent sprints.

Stakeholder Communication: Provide consistent, data-driven updates to senior leadership on

campaign health, emerging risks, and strategic recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing campaign performance data, identifying which teams are on pace and

where intervention is needed. Mid-morning, you're partnering with a District Manager and technical

resources to finalize targeting and messaging for an upcoming sales play. After lunch, you facilitate the

weekly campaign standup — a fast-paced inspection cadence where leaders report on execution, share

wins, and escalate blockers. In the afternoon, you're building the closed-loop report that ties pipeline

back to the campaigns that sourced it, drafting the narrative for leadership on what's working and what

needs to pivot.

No two days look the same, but the throughline is consistent: you're the connective tissue between

strategy and execution, ensuring the sales org runs with operational rigor while front-line leaders stay

focused on their sellers and deals.

About The Team

Our mission: **We help builders win. We remove barriers, unlock growth, and deliver the cloud

foundation that turns innovative ideas into transformative businesses.**

The Cloud Sales Center (CSC) is an inside sales organization within AWS that serves startup customers

across North America. Our team of 60+ sellers across six districts drives revenue growth through high-

velocity sales motions, covering Engaged accounts, Early-Stage startups, Migration opportunities, and

our Canada segment. We operate with programmatic rigor — running sprint-based campaigns,

measuring what matters, and iterating fast. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced,

metrics-driven environment and is energized by building the operational engine that makes an entire

sales org execute at a higher level.

Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
